The user didn't specify an artist but we can set artist to "Eric Church". They want songs from the album "Chief". So we call Music_3_LookupMusic with artist="Eric Church", album="Chief". Genre? They said hillbilly songs; maybe we can set genre to "dontcare" because they didn't specify a particular genre filter beyond wanting hillbilly. But we could also set genre to "Country"? But the user explicitly says "Hillbilly songs." That might correspond to country. But we don't have a "Hillbilly" genre in the function options. There's "Country" available. So we can set genre to "Country". Year? Not specified. So we set year to "dontcare".

{

    "album": "Chief",
    "genre": "Country",
    "year": "dontcare"
}

But the function expects year to be a number or "dontcare". We'll pass "dontcare" as string? Actually the type says year?: number, default: "dontcare". So we should pass year: "dontcare" or omit it. Let's just omit year.
